Description

Currently consisting of four employees, Studio Kette is dedicated to bringing accessible and enjoyable video game experiences to marginalized audiences. Our pilot project Prophecy of Vul is our initial foray into the industry and we are looking to only develop and hone our skills in our respective fields to bring the best out of ourselves!

History

Studio Kette was formed from a wish to stop making unfinished student projects and actually commit to a vision for a complete game. The company behind the studio is intentionally split between its employees with no CEO. The vision for the future is to keep the company model as is even should more people join the journey to prove there are other options for business than rigid capitalist hierarchies.
